name: Naga, Contender
body:
NAGA, CONTENDER
CR 7

XP 3,200
CG Large aberration
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+4 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)
hp 68 (8d8+32)
Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +8
Defensive Abilities courageous resilience, ferocity

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +11 (2d6+6)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks heroic blessing
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +8)

Constant–detect good

Spells Known (CL 5th; concentration +8)

2nd (5/day)—shield other, summon monster II
1st (7/day)—divine favor, moment of greatness, protection from evil, true strike 0 (at will)—detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, mending, message, prestidigitation

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 18, Con 19, Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 17
Base Atk +6; CMB +11; CMD 25 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Casting, Eschew Materials, Furious Focus, Improved Initiative, Power Attack
Skills Diplomacy +16, Escape Artist +17, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (history) +14, Perception +15, Spellcraft +14
Languages Common, Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Courageous Resilience (Ex)

Whenever a contender naga attempts a saving throw, they may roll twice and take the higher result. As an immediate action, a contender naga may grant an ally within 30 feet the benefits of this ability for 1 round.

Heroic Blessing (Su)

Contender naga gain a +2 morale bonus on all attack rolls and skill checks they make. As a move action once per day, they may instead transfer this benefit to another creature within 60 feet for a duration of 1 minute. The naga may revoke and regain the bonus at any time as a free action.

Spell Casting

A contender naga casts spells as a 5th-level sorcerer, although it is capable of learning any spells from the paladin spell list that lack the lawful descriptor and casting them as arcane spells.

ABOUT

Feats of individual heroism and daring recklessness can lead to a scaled person’s body toughening through each reincarnation, eventually producing the formidable and tenacious contender naga. Having cultivated an irrepressible resolve and a hunger for justice, contender naga utilize their magical abilities to protect and embolden those who could not fend for themselves.
